instruction: SQLite3 CREATE TABLE with CHECK constraint
output: sqlite3 /home/user/data.db 'CREATE TABLE products (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, price REAL CHECK(price > 0));'
sqlite3 /home/user/data.db 'INSERT OR REPLACE INTO products (id, name, price) VALUES (1, "Widget", 9.99);'
sqlite3 /home/user/data.db 'INSERT OR IGNORE INTO products (id, name, price) VALUES (1, "Widget", 9.99);'
